source_evidence.qualification_scope: Five source-qualified CVPR2026 main papers; source qualification is not runtime/capacity/legal redistribution approval.

paper.title: ViT³: Unlocking Test-Time Training in Vision

repository.official_link_evidence: Primary CVF/complete PDF and author repository qualification recorded in candidate_backbones.json; reused fixed source evidence, not a new author inertial implementation.

source_recheck.method: Each actual core raw file SHA/byte count verified and AST parsed, no upstream module imported. Fixed root LICENSE raw bytes fetched/hash matched and saved unmodified using apply_patch. Prior complete primary PDF qualification reused from source evidence; no datasets/weights fetched.

adaptation.selected_core: Input-only single-step fast weights: simplified SwiGLU global branch and depthwise local branch; not generic attention or label-based test-time optimization.
adaptation.draft_recipe_status: Explicit compact width/depth/patch/operator/initialization hypotheses; not original full visual-model profile, measured capacity, accuracy, latency or final-initialization parity.
adaptation.initialization: Source core w1/w2/w3 truncated-normal std0.02 retained; newly constructed temporal stem/wrappers and nn.Linear defaults are an adapter initialization recipe, not full visual-model seeded/final-init parity.
adaptation.readout: Final LayerNorm, temporal mean of patch tokens, one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head.
keep: Q/K/V projections into global multi-head and local head-width branches
Per-sample/per-head w1/w2 and per-sample grouped convolution fast weights, all reset from base nn.Parameters on every call
Negative-dot-product closed-form inner gradients from current-window K/V only; normalize each gradient by its norm+1 and use one lr=1 full-token step
Updated simplified SwiGLU weights act on Q, local adapted convolution acts on Q, concatenate both branches and project
Pre-LN residual/GELU-MLP wrapper with no classifier, teacher or target access in forward
replace: RGB spatial patch embedding -> ordered Conv1d(6,32,kernel=4,stride=4) temporal patches within T200
Optional source 2D positional RoPE -> explicit 1D half-pair RoPE applied to global Q/K patch positions
Source 3x3 local inner DWConv -> 3-tap temporal DWConv
Source nine-position equivalent-neighborhood scale 9**-0.5 -> explicit three-position scale 3**-0.5
Visual task wrapper/head -> compact depth2 draft, final LayerNorm/GAP and one XYZ Linear head/plain MSE
omitted: Image/detection/diffusion task wrappers and source supervised classifiers
Source 2D neighborhoods, image spatial geometry and unused full visual stages
External optimizer or state cache for inner updates
paper_code_adapter_differences: 1D RoPE, three-tap local neighborhoods and scale1/sqrt3 are adapter hypotheses, not algebraic equivalence to the published spatial model.
Outer velocity MSE is supervised; input-only negative-dot inner objective is a retained architecture computation, not a hidden target-task auxiliary loss.
Whole-window inner compression is window_noncausal, not a causal online algorithm.
D32/H4/depth2/MLP2/p4 is an unmeasured compact draft, not original paper size/capacity or initialization parity.
adaptation.objective: Shared plain supervised MSE over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity only; set_loss rejects non-MSE or kwargs. No source-task/SSL/teacher losses mixed into this identity.
adaptation.input_permissions: Same admitted reference_oracle six-axis task view as controls; no image/text/skeleton/geography/initial velocity/extra sensor/targets in forward/per-test fitting.
adaptation.temporal_scope: window_noncausal; only admitted T200 samples, no outside-window context or persistent fast weights/hidden state/maps.
risks: Inner compute must be charged to measured efficiency; no free TTT-cost claim.
Per-forward parameter invariance, batch separability, independent windows, values and inner gradients await server tests.
Neither source vision results nor input-only adaptation establishes inertial superiority or online deployability.

scientific_contract.output: vel:B,3 real supervised XYZ average velocity in m/s; no zero-padded Z
scientific_contract.xy_semantics: XY is the slice of the same XYZ prediction, no second XY model/head
scientific_contract.task_head: Final LayerNorm, temporal mean of patch tokens, one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head.
scientific_contract.optional_ssl_or_auxiliary_recipe: Not selected; any future source-specific loss requires separately named preregistered identity and budget.
